verifications.claim: The 2026 UFL season features eight teams.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "The UFL remains an eight-team league for 2026" (R1); "UFL set to kick off 2026 season with 8 teams" (R2); "the United Football League will feature eight teams" (R5); "All eight teams finalized their 50-man rosters" (R6); "The UFL features eight teams" (R7)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state eight teams for 2026.

verifications.claim: The eight teams follow a merger of the USFL and XFL.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "formed after the USFL-XFL merger ahead of the 2024 season" (R1); "the merger of the XFL and the USFL" (R3); "created after the merger of the XFL and the USFL" (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm the league's origin from USFL-XFL merger.

verifications.claim: The teams are organized into a single league.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "no longer operating as a two-division league. All eight teams will compete in one division"
verifications.reasoning: Directly states single division structure for all teams.

verifications.claim: The 2026 UFL teams are the Birmingham Stallions, Columbus Aviators, Dallas Renegades, DC Defenders, Houston Gamblers, Louisville Kings, Orlando Storm, and St. Louis Battlehawks.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: Lists exact teams: "Birmingham Stallions, Columbus Aviators, Dallas Renegades, DC Defenders, Houston Gamblers, Louisville Kings, Orlando Storm, St. Louis Battlehawks" (R1, R2, R5, R6, R7)

verifications.claim: Pro Football Newsroom notes AJ McCarron as head coach of the Birmingham Stallions.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: R3 (pfnewsroom.com) discusses 2024 teams, Stallions under Skip Holtz, mentions McCarron as player prospect not coach; R1, R6 confirm McCarron as 2026 coach but not from Pro Football Newsroom
verifications.reasoning: R3 (Pro Football Newsroom) does not note McCarron as coach; it covers 2024 with different coach.

verifications.evidence: "The Columbus Aviators... set to compete in their inaugural UFL seasons in 2026" (R1); "The Columbus Aviators are one of the newest teams" (R5)
